name: common-mod
description: Claude Code mods (function hooks that draw inside the CLI and the desktop Code tab): recall — /recall or the 回想 button opens a band above the prompt to search past Claude Code, desktop and Cowork conversations, preview their exchanges, branch one into a new window or put a summary of it in the prompt box; side — /side or the 側聊 button opens a side-chat pane docked beside the transcript like the diff panel (answers from a fork of this conversation, no tools), with a button to go on as a branch in a new window (switch model there, use tools), whose 帶回主線 sends a summary back to the main session; bar — a two-rail status line above the prompt: folder, model and animated ctx, 5h and 7d gauges, then buttons for 側聊, 回想, diff, artifacts, 看不懂 (/common:wait-what), 畫給我看 (/common:show-me) and 下一步 (next-step suggestions put in the prompt box as a draft).

recallExtraRoots.title: recall：其他對話紀錄資料夾
recallExtraRoots.description: 除了 ~/.claude/projects 之外要一起搜尋的資料夾，用分號分隔，例如 WSL 的 \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\<you>\.claude\projects
